slides.title: An API answers when you ask
slides.body: Your CRM asks the accounting system whether an invoice was paid. Asking on a schedule is called polling.

slides.title: A webhook tells you when it happens
slides.body: A deposit clears and the payment provider tells your booking system at once, so nothing has to keep asking.

slides.title: Webhooks need careful receiving
slides.body: Verify the signature, expect duplicates, don't rely on order, and reply fast before doing the work.

slides.title: Decide which system wins
slides.body: If an address changes in two tools on the same day, one has to be the source of truth. Write it down.

slides.title: Know when it breaks
slides.body: A daily check that totals match on both sides catches a silent failure the same day, not at month end.
